# Game design brief

Status: proposed — requirements not yet approved.

## Pitch and references

One-sentence fantasy; reference games and what we like about them.

## Player and platforms

Audience, session length, desktop/mobile targets, supported browsers, controls, orientation, and accessibility goals.

## Core loop

What the player repeatedly does, meaningful choices, feedback, win/loss states, restart, and progression.

## First vertical slice

Smallest end-to-end playable proof. Define observable acceptance criteria.

## Scope

Must have / should have / later. Explicit non-goals and content quantity.

## Art and audio

Visual direction, resolution/scaling, asset pipeline, music/SFX, mute/volume, attribution.

## Technical decisions

Engine choice and reason; frame/load budgets and test device; storage/save schema; pause/focus behavior; offline/network requirements. Backend needs are a separate decision.

## Release criteria

Link issues/milestone, specific playtests, supported inputs, quality checks, known risks, and acceptance owner.

## Open questions and approvals

Record decisions, dates, and changes here. Do not silently treat assumptions as approved requirements.
